variants.note: Board centred in a 50x50 tile. It sits just BELOW the female thread ring (not inside it, unlike the 8x module in the 58 dome) so the USB-C and JST plugs reach the board edge under the ring. A 0.6 mm clamp lip under the ring (inner dia 38 = the lid's light bore) presses the board's r 19-20 edge band against the back posts and stops the lid.

notes: Rev 2.0 round board (2026-08-25 layout), 16x SK6812 RGBW. Derived from hardware/kicad/LED_Module_CH32V203.kicad_pcb on 2026-09-29: Edge.Cuts = one circle, centre (135,95) r 20. ORIENTATION: like the 1.42in display, the payload (all 16 LEDs + their caps) is on KiCad's B side and the MCU, USB-C, JST, LDO and crystal on F. Coordinates are the PAYLOAD view (looking at the LEDs), the same convention as every other noknok profile: x = kx - 115, y = ky - 75 (KiCad file coords, i.e. the KiCad top view mirrored in Y). Connectors: J1 GCT USB4105 USB-C, mouth flush on the W board edge (signal pads at the rear); J3 JST-SH horizontal (custom library footprint, same geometry as SM04B-SRSS-TB: signal pads at local y=-2, mouth at +y) opens N. The 8x module's vertical JST and 8.5 mm 2-pin header are GONE (J2 is now a solder jumper), so the deep 9 mm plenum is no longer needed. clearance_bottom 3.5 = the USB-C receptacle (~3.3 mm, tallest F-side part; JST 2.95, SOT-223 LDO ~1.8) + margin - caliper it. clearance_top 1.6 = SK6812 5050 PLCC4 height. Mounting: 4x M2.5 on a 25 mm square (r 17.7 from centre); the (7.5,7.5) hole is the noknok_FlashPads_USB-module footprint, the other three plain noknok_MountingHole_2.5mm. LED keep-in: 12 outer LEDs on r 14.5 + 4 inner on a 7.4 mm square; every B-side part stays inside r 18.9, so the r 19-20 edge band is free for a collar/lip to press on. top_feature = a fully open d38 LED face.
